94b25974d5.group_remark: `ChipletSelectors` struct now threaded as parameter; selector access changed from field lookup to method call, shifting line numbers.

39e1e3a01f.group_remark: New last-row constraints enforce all chiplet selectors equal 1 at the final trace row.

fa79579f7d.group_remark: `when_transition()` guard removed; transition gate now multiplied directly into each constraint expression.

7a366bde1f.group_remark: Per-bus domain tag added to `Challenges` encoding; each bus constraint now includes a distinct domain separator.

c14fd13f56.group_remark: Small helper function inlined; constraint expression unchanged, only call-site location moved.

ac2a1ba98b.group_remark: Constraint style refactor: gates factored into when() chains, semantic assertions applied. 7 sign flips (assert_zero(g*(1-x)) → when(g).assert_one(x)) and 3 constraints gained is_transition factor (op flags vanish on last row, so constraints were already vacuous there). All changes are semantically equivalent.
